notes: INA series 26631, variable 'Caudal medio diario' (daily mean flow), station Rosario (INA station 34, Prefectura Naval Argentina code 280) (INA a5 API).

INA labels this daily series 'medición directa' and gives no per-reading series here; on the Parana INA's flow series elsewhere are labeled as computed from a rating curve ('Curva de gasto'), and we did not find how this one is computed (INA a5 API).
INA publishes no per-value quality flag, so every value is marked measured, including the most recent days, which INA may still correct (INA a5 API).
